activity.notes: After the formal regency ended, Catherine remained an influential queen mother in French politics until her death in 1589. The 1564 start marks the post-regency political phase rather than the beginning of her queen-mother status itself; therefore ATLAS uses general_activity and active_in rather than extending the regency.

sources.title: Catherine de' Medici, Queen and Regent of France — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Catherine as Queen of France from 1547 and Regent from 1560 to 1563, and notes her continuing political influence after the regency.

sources.title: Caterina de' Medici regina di Francia — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani describes Catherine as the central political arbiter after 1560 and notes that her influence later declined under Henry III, supporting a post-regency political-activity phase rather than a continuous formal regency.
